The main coverage limitation is fixture-only repository/transaction testing: RepositoryContractsTest is parameterized solely with IN_MEMORY, while FixtureRepositoryPolicies, InMemoryCodexLikesTransactions, and InMemoryRepositories mirror production behavior.
ApplicationDataReadinessTest, GroupedSearchPagingTest, and SearchMetadataHydrationTest contain unbounded readiness waits; focused timeouts would reduce hang risk without retries or sleeps.
SearchMetadataHydrationTest uses a 100 ms source timeout, which is a potential wall-clock sensitivity under host load, though no failure was observed.
